item_specifications.special_feature: Non Skid Bottom, Orthopedic, Removable Cover, Washable

about_item: Orthopedic Support: High density 3 inch egg crate foam is soft and elastic to help distribute weight evenly and gently cradle your pet's entire body to relieve pressure on his joints, especially suitable for older dogs and large dogs with arthritis; featuring a spacious 26"x22" sleeping surface, our orthopedic dog bed is designed to offer your pet unparalleled support for a deep, dreamy sleep

Sofa Bed Design: The 3-sided 3.5 inch bolster design promotes ultimate comfort and security, offering your pet a variety of cozy positions to snuggle; the cushioned bolster shape is fully filled to support your pet’s head and neck for a more restful sleep; further more, there is a touch fastener attached which makes it available for you to put two dog beds together for a extra large one

Soft Velvet and Waterproof Surface: The PV velvet brush flower composite surface and crystal super soft bolster of the dog bed offer maximum comfort for your furry friends; your pups can enjoy a peaceful and restful sleep; and there is a waterproof layer attached on the cover to protect the egg crate foam from getting wet

Care Instruction: Our large dog beds boasts a removable bed cover, there are zippers on the top and bottom which make it easier to assemble or disassemble for quick cleaning and easy care; before putting into washing machine, please make sure the foam and bolster fillings are removed, and the zippers are closed

Pet Safe Design: Pet Crafted with your pet's safety in mind, this dog bed is certified to OEKO-TEX Standard 100, ensuring that every material used meets stringent safety criteria; the foam inside is CertiPUR-US certified; plus, the non-skid bottom adds extra stability, minimizing slips and keeping your pet safe

This dog bed comes in two bolster styles: removable bolster and integrated bolster; All bolster covers are removable and washable for convenient care – please note the cover style delivered will be random, and this variation does not affect the bed’s safety, comfort or regular use

authors_reviews.title: High quality, easy to clean, $$ well spent!!
authors_reviews.text: Perfect bed! Bought this for my australian cattle dog’s surgery recovery (he’s okay, just a neuter!) and my dog loves it. Took some getting used to for him because our bed & couch is his bed. 😂 Bought it on sale and was around $30 after tax. Pet stores charge well over $50, sometimes closer to $80 and higher for beds of this quality. It comes in 3 pieces and it very easy to assemble. It also made me realize just how easy it will be to wash, yay! Onyx loves his new bed and it’s definitely comfortable and plush. Perfect size for a cattle dog!
authors_reviews.author: Rae

authors_reviews.title: Dog Loves it
authors_reviews.text: My dog loves this breed already.The cover seems really high quality with a very thick no slip bottom and fuzzy top. My dog knew it was due him right away and couldn't wait to lay on it while I was putting it together. It comes in 3 pieces and is simple to set up. Looks like washing will be easy as well.I got the extra large and my 75 pound mutt fits just fine. He's the size of a tall skinny German shepherd.

No where for hairs to attach except the material side where the dog lays, which is washable, but we do put a soft throw over it. Best bed I’ve ever bought for our Weimaraner.
authors_reviews.author: Kathy R.

authors_reviews.title: This made a huge difference in my dog!
authors_reviews.text: This bed was so easy to put together and the egg crate cushion is perfect for my elderly dog. He has never liked dog beds before, but this one he gets into every single day we love it.! and I’m so happy to have him feeling better since he’s been sleeping in the bed. He eats better and is more alert. I think it’s because sleeping in. It takes the pain and pressure off of his hip joints and he feels better. I want to think the designers of this bed for making it such a special place for my dog to sleep!
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer

authors_reviews.title: Nice and sturdy for senior dogs who like to dig!
authors_reviews.text: My dogs are still getting used to them, but they are seniors and change comes with trial. They're well made, easy to put together, and I LOVE that the cushion and bolster have a protective cover on them, and that they slip into the cover separately. If I need to wash the cover, I simply unzip each section, slip out the bolster and pad, and toss the cover in the washing machine. Additionally, my dogs like to "fluff" their beds and dig at them. The big boy is strong enough, he normally tears the fabric. Not this time! Neither have put holes in their beds, so far.
authors_reviews.author: Miranda Pace
